text:
WATCH LIVE: Disney Believe Reveal | Disney Cruise Line Ship Announcement
Join us October 7 at 4:30 p.m. ET for the reveal of Disney Cruise Line’s next ship, the Disney Believe! Find out never-before-released details, including the ship’s homeport, itineraries, new venues, family dining and entertainment.

Setting sail in late 2027, the Disney Believe promises one-of-a-kind venues and entertainment experiences that will be shaped by some of Disney’s most beloved stories, including Disney Animation’s Encanto, Frozen, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, Moana and The Little Mermaid.

Now, there’s only one thing left to ask … do you believe?
